_comment: Compiler caches of the offload build hosts (#307, docs/worker-offload.md#compiler-cache). The remote build scripts install the pinned release per build user under the host's work directory (no admin, no sudo), check its SHA-256 and pass it as CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER; a host that cannot fetch or verify it builds without a cache. The cache itself lives in the work directory too.

windows._hostMaxSize: Per-host override of the cache size PER SLOT (hosts not listed keep maxSize split into five equal shares). The key is the host's COMPUTERNAME. tools/offload/windows_cache_environment.ps1 trims a slot back to the share while the cache drive is low on disk (100 GB free for overrides of 40G or more, 45 GB below that, 60 GB for a relocated cache).
windows._hostCacheDir: Per-host absolute cache directory (slot dirs slot-N below it); if the drive is missing the host falls back to its default base directory and the old 2G share and logs it.
